chunks: Muḥammad ibn Muslim narrated from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
"What the water has cast out from the fish, and that from which the water has receded, is not to be eaten; that is the abandoned one."

key_terms.الْمَاءُ: the water, referring to the body of water from which the fish came
key_terms.لَا يُؤْكَلُ: it is not to be eaten; a prohibition on consumption
key_terms.نَبَذَهُ: cast it out or threw it out

ai.seo_question: Is fish thrown out by the water or left behind after the water recedes halal to eat?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding fish that are found cast out by the water or left exposed after the water has receded. Such fish are deemed abandoned and are not lawful to eat.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4206 - It is narrated from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja'far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as), who said:
"That which is thrown out by the water from the fish and that which the water recedes from should not be eaten, for that is considered abandoned."
